caption: The drawing depicts a metallic horse figure in profile, facing to the left. The horse is rendered in shades of bronze and gold with mild variations indicating a weathered or patinated surface. The horse's right front leg is raised, and its mane and tail are stylized with flowing lines. The tail curves downward and is defined by parallel lines creating a segmented appearance. The horse stands upon a horizontal bar, also depicted in a bronze or gold tone, that runs parallel to the bottom edge of the image. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Weather Vane Horse
